sources.title: GitHub - Graphlet-AI/eridu: Deep fuzzy matching people and company ...
sources.snippet: This model is available on HuggingFace Hub as Graphlet-AI/eridu and can be used in any Python project using the Sentence Transformers library in five lines of code. The model is designed to be used for entity resolution tasks, such as matching people and company names across different languages and character sets when matching records.
